purpose: Test whether the two-stage 3-state classifier improves state quality, fault/degraded recall or compute over a standard direct multinomial classifier in the same synthetic mission holdout.

classifiers.hierarchical_reference: Frozen saved two-stage calibrated logistic classifiers, selected stage1=50 and stage2=10 (union=59).
classifiers.direct_union59: Train multinomial LogisticRegression C=0.5 class_weight=balanced max_iter=700 on exact union of saved stage1+stage2 selected features; StandardScaler train-only; temperature calibration using only mission2.
classifiers.direct_all400: Train identical direct multinomial estimator and temperature calibration on all 400 original features.
classifiers.hierarchical_refit_timing: Fit same stage1+stage2 classifiers with frozen 50/10 features and Platt calibrators using original fit/cal mission; timing only; verify unchanged holdout probabilities.

postprocessors: same previously trained transition/prior causal HMM filter, gamma .6 memory .5 for all static models
decision_rule: No new model selection based on mission3 results; report every method, no 'winner' chosen by test.

timing.train_time_scope: model fit including calibration but excluding original feature-selection search
timing.prediction_time_scope: 272 windows excluding raw telemetry feature extraction and abnormal branch

note: This is exploratory posthoc ablation on previously assessed synthetic data; reproducible but not an untouched independent confirmation. Physical satellite fault truth does not exist here.
